scripts.pages:dev: concurrently -n functions,vite -c blue,green "wrangler pages dev dist --port 8788" "vite"
scripts.pages:dev:resilient: concurrently -n functions,vite -c blue,green "bash -c 'while true; do wrangler pages dev dist --port 8788; echo [pages:dev] wrangler exited, restarting in 1s - see README for why this can happen; sleep 1; done'" "vite"
scripts.pages:deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist
